title: Should I Follow Al-based Advice? Measuring Appropriate Reliance in Human-Al Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper focuses on the cognitive and behavioral aspects of human reliance on AI systems. It proposes a metric for measuring 'appropriate reliance' in decision-making tasks. While the decisions themselves (e.g., medical or financial) can have ethical dimensions, the paper does not evaluate, benchmark, or engage with ethical, moral, or religious frameworks. Its primary domain is human-computer interaction and cognitive science.
